pages.alt: Morning in the kitchen. Morgan, stirring a bowl, says: "Ethan. Shoes. Rowan's looking for his again." Ethan answers: "Got it, Hun." Rowan sits on the entry bench wearing one shoe. Ethan crouches and holds out the missing sneaker. Rowan: "It wasn't there before." Ethan: "Very sneaky shoe." Morgan straightens Ethan's shirt and says: "What would I do without you?" In the last panel Ethan turns, smiling, as a voice from off-panel calls: "Ethan?"

By the coat hooks, Riley works at her purple hoodie's zipper and says: "I can do it myself." Ruby, sitting on a stool, replies: "Okay. I'm here if you need me." Ethan watches from the kitchen. The zipper goes up with a "zzip" and Riley grins: "See?" As Riley walks off to join Rowan, Ruby asks Ethan: "Do you think I handled that right? I nearly took over." Ethan, crouched beside her: "You did fine. She needed you to listen. You listened." Ruby smiles: "Thanks." Morgan appears in the doorway behind them.

Morgan leans in the doorway: "Ruby. You two planning on staying in here all morning?" Ruby, with Rowan and Riley beside her: "He's giving me a pep talk." Morgan: "Of course he is." Morgan kisses Ethan on the cheek while Ruby smiles. A close-up shows Ruby's hand, wearing her ring, resting on Ethan's as she says: "Your shirt's crooked again." Morgan: "I just fixed that." Ethan laughs: "Thanks anyway, Morgan." The whole family is gathered, with Avery at the table holding a spoon and laughing.

Ethan stands alone at the bathroom sink, facing the mirror. Narration: "Morgan trusts me to follow her." Closer on his reflection: "Ruby trusts me to lead her." Closer still, his expression uncertain: "Sometimes I wonder which one of them actually knows me." The final panel pulls back to show him leaning on the sink: "Sometimes I wonder if I do." Title: Three Hearts, Different Needs.

Morgan packs a big olive canvas bag at the kitchen table. Ruby asks: "You taking the big bag?" Morgan: "I'm trying to travel light." Ruby laughs: "Ambitious." Ethan walks in as Ruby heads out and says: "This looks optimistic." Morgan, pushing a blanket into the bag: "We're doing it this way." Ethan: "All that in one bag?" Morgan lifts it by the straps: "One bag. Two free hands."

Ethan leans on the table beside the packed bag and a blue water bottle: "You know I can still tell you when that's a terrible idea." Morgan smirks: "You usually do." A close-up shows Ethan trying to fit the bottle in on top of the blanket. Ethan: "This is one of those times." Morgan holds out her hand: "All right. Show me."

Ethan slides the water bottle into the bag's outside pocket: "Outside pocket." Morgan: "That's what it's for." Then: "Fine. You get one point." Ethan: "I'm keeping score now." Morgan sets the strap on his shoulder: "You can carry your victory." Ethan: "Gladly." As they head out, Ethan says: "No promises." Morgan, glancing back: "Try to keep up."

Ruby sits at the kitchen table with a mug of coffee as Ethan walks over. Ruby: "Bag sorted?" Ethan: "After extensive negotiations." She slides a second mug toward him: "Yours is there." Ethan sits: "Thanks, Babe." He looks down at the mug and goes quiet. Ruby, watching him with worried eyes: "Are you upset with me?"

Ethan, arms folded on the table, answers gently: "No, Babe." Ruby: "You went quiet." Ethan: "Just thinking." Ruby: "About what?" Ethan glances toward the packed bag by the bench: "Whether we forgot anything." Ruby taps the list in front of her and smiles: "We haven't." Ethan: "Good."

Standing by the table, Ruby gestures to his untouched mug: "You can have your coffee, you know." Ethan: "In a minute." He leans his forehead against hers: "You all right?" Ruby, eyes closed, smiling: "I am." Ethan: "Good." Her hand rests on his arm. In the last panel the two walk away together, leaving the full mug on the table.

Rowan, holding a small blue toy bridge, points to the mug on the table: "You forgot your coffee." Ruby and Ethan turn back from the doorway. Ethan picks up the mug: "I was letting it cool." Rowan grins: "It's working." Ethan sits beside Ruby and drinks: "Thanks." Rowan wanders off, turning the bridge in his hands.

Avery sits at the table with a spoon and her striped cup, tapping out a rhythm while Ruby and Ethan watch, smiling. Ruby leans in: "One more round?" Ethan grins at Avery: "You've got a whole band in here." Ruby laughs: "We're still auditioning." Avery beams, spoon raised, as Ethan folds his arms and smiles.

Ruby holds up a small card with a picture of a spoon and a picture of sneakers: "Last little bit, then shoes." Avery taps one more beat with her eyes closed. Avery hands the spoon to Ethan, who holds out his hand: "I've got it." Avery puts on her lavender sneakers on a stool while Ruby watches. Avery stands up, smiling at Ethan: "Ready."

In the entryway, Riley kneels on the bench with her hands curled like paws: "I'm a cat." Ethan and Morgan sit with her. Ethan: "I thought cats slept all morning." Riley: "Not this one." Morgan gestures to the floor: "Then land on both feet." Riley lands with her hands on her hips: "Easy." Ethan, crouching and smiling: "Definitely a cat."

At the kitchen table, Rowan sets the blue toy bridge on two blocks: "This is a bridge." Riley, making paws: "For cats." Avery holds up another block: "Higher." Close on hands adding the block to raise the bridge. Ethan, Ruby, Rowan, Riley and Avery gather around it, smiling. Ethan's thought caption: "For a second, it's easy."
